nameMustContainLetterOrNumber: Template name must contain at least one letter or number.
nameTooLong: Template name is too long — Meta allows at most 512 characters.
bodyRequired: Add the message body — this is what your learners will read.
bodyTooLong: Body text is {{length}} characters; Meta allows at most {{max}}.
sequenceMustStartAtOne: {{where}} variables must start at {{startToken}} — found {{found}} first.
sequenceMustBeConsecutive: {{where}} variables must be numbered consecutively — {{missing}} is missing but {{used}} is used.
bodyCannotStartWithVariable: Body text cannot start with a variable — put some words before it.
bodyCannotEndWithVariable: Body text cannot end with a variable — add a word or punctuation after it.
sampleValueEmpty: Sample value for variable {{index}} is empty — Meta needs one example per variable to review the template.
headerTextMissing: Header is set to Text but no header text was entered.
headerTooLong: Header text is {{length}} characters; Meta allows at most {{max}}.
headerTooManyVariables_one: A text header can contain at most one variable; this one has {{count}}.
headerTooManyVariables_other: A text header can contain at most one variable; this one has {{count}}.
headerSampleValueMissing: The header variable needs a sample value for Meta to review it.
headerSampleUrlRequired: A sample {{type}} URL is required for {{type}}-header templates.
headerSampleUrlExpiring: The sample {{type}} link is a temporary signed URL (it carries a Signature/Expires parameter) and will stop working once it expires — Meta would approve the template, then every send would fail. Use Upload to host the file permanently instead.
footerTooLong: Footer is {{length}} characters; Meta allows at most {{max}}.
footerCannotContainVariables: Footers cannot contain variables — remove the {{token}} from the footer.
tooManyButtons: A template can have at most {{max}} buttons.
buttonTextTooLong: {{label}} label is {{length}} characters; Meta allows at most {{max}}.
buttonNoUrl: {{label}} is a URL button but has no link.
buttonUrlProtocol: {{label}} link must start with http:// or https://.
buttonUrlSampleMissing: {{label}} has a variable in its link, so it needs a sample URL for Meta to review.
buttonNoPhone: {{label}} is a phone button but has no number.
buttonPhoneFormat: {{label}} number must be in international format, e.g. +919876543210.
onlyOnePhoneButton: Only one phone-number button is allowed per template.
